checks: ordinary web sources never submit PDFs or advertise scholarly extraction
double activation rechecks capability once and starts with its current result-key precondition
document changes abort pending checks and ignore stale parsed capabilities
storage/import disabling that changes during an awaited check prevents extraction
cancellation has explicit processing/cancelling/uncertain states and reconciliation instead of an assumed rollback
passive native/TEI download controls require attachment metadata and unmount aborts pending work
scope: Actual React component; synthetic deferred capability requests, no native execution.
